question_text: Describe how two restricted read-only views could let tutors and finance staff see different data from the same underlying student database.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: A tutor view exposes educational fields/rows needed for teaching, while a finance view exposes payment fields. Users receive access to their appropriate view rather than unrestricted base tables, limiting disclosure and preventing edits through those read-only views.
